Validation before asynchronous image admission, CPU creation or Worker replacement

limitations: No actual guest firmware, engine, browser, filesystem or physical device was executed.
Card identities, timing, SDSC geometry and read-only PIO remain the existing component fixtures.
Public UI supplies no SD cards; browser delivery and whole-firmware storage require separate source-pinned acceptance.
Raw SD contents may be exposed by future guest outputs, which need their own evidence review.
